record.paper_title: Hénon maps: a list of open problems
record.context_brief: symplectic automorphisms of C^2 without periodic points
record.original_question: Construct an entire symplectic automorphism of C^2 with no periodic point but with a nonempty set of Lyapunov-unstable points whose orbits stay bounded.

evidence.quote: Problem 1. — Construct an entire symplectic automorphism of C2 without periodic point and with non-empty set of (Lyapunov) unstable points with bounded orbit.

artifact.status_search_result: The problem is stated as an open construction problem in a recent list of open problems on Hénon maps (2023). Web searches did not turn up any published resolution; related works study Lyapunov exponents, stability and hyperbolicity of polynomial automorphisms of C^2 but do not provide such a construction.

status_evidence.title: On stability and hyperbolicity for polynomial automorphisms of C^2
status_evidence.snippet: Weakly stable families are those where saddle periodic orbits do not bifurcate; a notion of regular point for polynomial automorphisms is introduced inspired by Pesin theory.
status_evidence.claim: Related work on stability of polynomial automorphisms of C^2 does not address the existence of entire symplectic automorphisms with no periodic points and non-empty bounded Lyapunov-unstable set.

status_evidence.title: Shift automorphisms in the Hénon mapping
status_evidence.snippet: For the Hénon map with A large the nonwandering set is conjugate to the full 2-shift.
status_evidence.claim: Standard Hénon examples have abundant periodic points, so they cannot serve as candidates for this construction.
